description: This bar chart illustrates the accuracy scores for two models, MMAU and MMAR, across three different datasets: Qwen2-Audio-Instruct, Audio-Reasoner, and Qwen-2.5-Omni. The horizontal axis displays the dataset names in the order Qwen2-Audio-Instruct, Audio-Reasoner, and Qwen-2.5-Omni, and is labeled “Datasets”. The vertical axis, labeled “Accuracy (%)”, represents a linear scale ranging from 0 to 70, with tick marks at 10-unit intervals. Two bars are present for each dataset, representing the accuracy of each model; the bars are side-by-side. The MMAU model is represented by light blue bars, while the MMAR model is represented by dark blue bars. For Qwen2-Audio-Instruct, MMAU achieves approximately 52% accuracy and MMAR achieves approximately 30% accuracy. For Audio-Reasoner, MMAU reaches approximately 60% accuracy and MMAR reaches approximately 45% accuracy. Finally, for Qwen-2.5-Omni, MMAU achieves approximately 65% accuracy and MMAR achieves approximately 55% accuracy. The bars are not explicitly sorted, and no bars are visually emphasized.
